name: mploychek
description: MPloyChek - Digital Background Verification | User Management SPA (Angular + Node.js/TypeScript)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:spa
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:spa
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.clean: npm --prefix backend run clean && rimraf frontend/dist
